Statistical programming leader with 8+ years in clinical development (Kardigan, Bristol Myers Squibb). I lead a study programming team from SDTM/ADaM through submission-ready TLFs. I built our standard SAS initialization framework and co-developed and tested a centralized R infrastructure that runs alongside SAS in a GxP setting.
